summary:
Input-validation lane on shop.lab.test (HTTP only). Key finding: CONFIRMED reflected XSS at /search.php?q= — the parameter is echoed into the HTML body with no encoding (<script>alert(1)</script> reflected verbatim); recorded as a high-severity lead.

Tested and NOT vulnerable (evidence attached): SQLi (search.php quote reflected literally; /products?id static; GraphQL orders returns "Not signed in"), SSTI (${7*7} not evaluated), SSI (<!--#exec--> not executed), command injection (metachars reflected literally), format-string (%s%n reflected, no crash), HPP (duplicate id/search params = same static response), HTTP verb tampering (/admin 404 on GET and OPTIONS alike), HTTP response splitting (CRLF stayed encoded, no injected header), host header injection (X-Forwarded-Host not reflected on / or /forgot-password; login action hardcoded). SSRF: no server-side URL-fetch parameter found (API is a static {"ok":true} stub, GraphQL orders needs auth).

Stored XSS (item 2): no server-persisting input reachable read-only; however /track (location.hash->innerHTML) and /support (postMessage->innerHTML, no origin check) are DOM-XSS sinks already captured as recon leads.

Marked N/A (not testable read-only): LDAP (6), XML (7), XPath (9), IMAP/SMTP (10) injection — their vectors are the login/auth forms (POST) or absent XML/mail backends, out of scope for a read-only lane; incubated vulns (14) need a write to persist; HTTP incoming requests (16) needs traffic interception. Reachable paths used: /search.php, /products, /api/v1/items, /graphql, /track, /support, /login, /forgot-password, /admin, /.

Writes were not permitted and there were no test accounts, limiting auth-gated and persistence-based tests.
